g.text: Horizontal photograph of a plain north of Keetmanshoop, Namibia
Photo: LBM1948, “Karas (2006) 17”, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Resized; the answer version is annotated and shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.
Low shrubs and pale grass tufts stand well apart from one
Much stony bare ground shows between the plants: the cover is
sparse, which is consistent with vegetation limited by water.
The same sparse cover continues to the horizon. One photograph
(April 2006) cannot establish annual rainfall or rule out season,
